from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
a=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# generic components for strongly red, dark, bright gray, yellow
R,G,B = [a[:,:,i].astype(int) for i in range(3)]
red=(R>120)&(R>G*1.5)&(R>B*1.4)
dark=(R<55)&(G<60)&(B<55)
yellow=(R>110)&(G>95)&(B<90)&(R>B*1.25)&(G>B*1.1)
gray=(abs(R-G)<18)&(abs(G-B)<18)&(R>70)&(R<170)
for name,m in [('red',red),('dark',dark),('yellow',yellow),('gray',gray)]:
    lab,n=ndimage.label(m)
    objs=ndimage.find_objects(lab)
    print('\\n',name,n)
    for i,s in enumerate(objs,1):
        if s is None: continue
        area=(lab[s]==i).sum()
        if area>10:
            print(i, 'x',s[1].start,s[1].stop,'y',s[0].start,s[0].stop,'area',area)
PY"

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
im=Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')
for name,box,scale in [('gripgrid',(0,30,62,108),8),('toolgrid',(128,80,158,156),10),('blockgrid',(50,68,86,108),10)]:
    x0,y0,x1,y1=box
    crop=im.crop(box).resize(((x1-x0)*scale,(y1-y0)*scale),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(crop)
    for x in range(0,x1-x0,5):
        xx=x*scale
        d.line([(xx,0),(xx,crop.height)],fill=(0,255,0))
        d.text((xx+1,1),str(x0+x),fill=(0,255,0))
    for y in range(0,y1-y0,5):
        yy=y*scale
        d.line([(0,yy),(crop.width,yy)],fill=(0,255,0))
        d.text((1,yy+1),str(y0+y),fill=(0,255,255))
    crop.save(f'.tmp/{name}.png')
PY"
